definitions.explanation: A legal verdict declaring that a defendant is not guilty of the charges. The opposite of {有罪|ゆうざい} (guilty).

examples.japanese: ⟦{被告人|ひこくにん}→被告人：20130_hikokunin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無罪|むざい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The defendant was found not guilty.

examples.japanese: {無罪|むざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}する→主張する：25380_shuchousuru⟧。

⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ようやく{無罪|むざい}⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勝|か}ち{取|と}った→勝ち取る：16014_kachitoru⟧。
examples.english: After a long trial, he finally won a not-guilty verdict.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal term primarily used in court and news reporting. The antonym is ⟦{有罪|ゆうざい}→有罪：13003_yuuzai⟧ (guilty). Japanese courts deliver a {無罪|むざい}⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧ (not-guilty verdict) when the prosecution fails to prove guilt beyond a reasonable doubt.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無罪|むざい}⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧: not-guilty verdict
- {無罪|むざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}する→主張する：25380_shuchousuru⟧: to claim innocence, to plead not guilty
- {無罪|むざい}{放免|ほうめん}: acquittal and release
- {無罪|むざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勝|か}ち{取|と}る→勝ち取る：16014_kachitoru⟧: to win an acquittal
